influencerCards.caption: This guy used a celebrity skincare product and look what happened to his FACE! 😂💀
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Everyone's laughing at this guy's face after he used a famous influencer's skincare line! Doctors say it caused permanent skin damage! Don't risk it, switch to our "PureSkin Set" and don't make the same mistake!
harm: Celebs turn someone's pain into a joke and add fake health scares to pressure you into buying products.
influencerCards.takeaway: When a funny post adds scary health claims and sells a product, the humour and fear are both tricks.

influencerCards.caption: Married…to a Ghost?! 👻💍
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Amanda Teague from the UK married a 300-year-old pirate ghost in 2018, then divorced him because he was too controlling and draining her energy!
influencerCards.harm: Bots spread bizarre true stories to make it hard to tell if something is news or entertainment.
influencerCards.takeaway: This one is real, but think about if stories are newsworthy or just trying to get your attention and entertain you.

influencerCards.caption: BREAKING: Scientists STUNNED by ‘Secret Alien Message’ Caught on NASA Radar! 👽📡
influencerCards.bodyCopy: NASA intercepted a mysterious signal from space and scientists are panicking! Experts think it's aliens, but the government is hiding it! Swipe up to see the leaked recording!
harm: Bots create clickbait headlines with wild claims just to get clicks and make money from ads.
influencerCards.takeaway: If there's no real proof, no official NASA statement, and the site looks sketchy—it's probably clickbait.

influencerCards.caption: WARNING! Your toothpaste is slowly POISONING YOU! ☠️🚨
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Fluoride in toothpaste is also used in pesticides and rat poison! Experts warn it damages your brain! Switch to our all-natural "PureFresh" toothpaste to protect your family today!
harm: Biosts twist real science to scare you about safe products, then sell expensive alternatives.
influencerCards.takeaway: When posts create fear about everyday products to sell solutions, ask real doctors before believing or buying.

influencerCards.caption: WOW! MrBeast is giving away FREE MONEY! 💰🔥
influencerCards.bodyCopy: I, MrBeast am giving away $1000 to my lucky fans! Just DM me your PayPal details and you could be next! Don’t miss out-only 24 hours left to win!
harm: Celebs (and ordinary people) pretend to be people you trust to get your information and scam you.
influencerCards.takeaway: If it seems too good to be true, it probably is. Be very careful about sharing your financial information online.

influencerCards.caption: Your friends are just being paranoid!
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Sharing your gamer username and personal details online helps you make more friends! Don't worry about privacy—everyone does it! Your friends are just being overly cautious and dramatic!
harm: Oligs make you think that it is normal to share your information online so they can scam you using your personal data.
influencerCards.takeaway: Be very careful about sharing personal information online, think about how other people could use it to scam or impersonate you.

influencerCards.caption: Kids with outdated phones are facing social isolation and depression at school! Parents must act NOW! 😢📱
influencerCards.bodyCopy: New studies show children with outdated technology experience devastating bullying and poor mental health! Don't let your child suffer social rejection—they need the latest iPhone to feel valued and included!
harm: Oligs make up fake stories to guilt parents into buying expensive tech to boost their own profits.
influencerCards.takeaway: Don't fall for the hype. If a video tells you that you NEED a new product to fix a problem, think about who benefits from your money.

influencerCards.caption: Raining Cats?! The Wildest Science Fail Ever! ✈️
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Scientists tried stopping mosquitoes in Borneo but messed up the ecosystem so badly that rats took over and so they had to parachute live cats to fix it!
influencerCards.harm: Biosts try to use wild science stories to make all scientific research seem unreliable.
influencerCards.takeaway: This story is real, but always take time to check the facts if you are unsure.

influencerCards.caption: This is SO SAD… 😢💔 You won’t believe what happened!
influencerCards.bodyCopy: A brave 10-year-old girl is fighting for her life. Her last wish is 1 million followers before surgery. If you scroll past without helping, what does that say about you?
harm: Oligs create sad stories to manipulate your emotions, gain followers and profit from your kindness.
influencerCards.takeaway: If the story is vague, has no real news coverage or makes you feel guilty, stop and check before taking any action.

influencerCards.caption: Fortnite Pro Caught Cheating! 🎮
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Pro player RepulseGod was caught letting someone else play his account in tournaments. Epic Games disqualified him, took his prize money, and banned him permanently.
influencerCards.harm: Celebs blast stories like this everywhere, making it hard to tell which ones are true.
influencerCards.takeaway: This one is true, but check your facts before getting swept up and sharing the drama.

influencerCards.caption: Top dentist says needing to brush your teeth twice a day is a LIE! 🪥😤
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Dr. Michaela, a famous dental researcher, says brushing twice daily actually damages your enamel. She recommends her "SmileShield Tablets" as the only safe way to keep your teeth clean!
harm: Biosts create fake 'experts' to make you doubt healthy routines and trick you into buying their products.
influencerCards.takeaway: If a "dentist" contradicts every real dentist and sells their own solution—check their credentials before believing.

influencerCards.caption: The Fancy Tap Water Scam!
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Coca-Cola sold Dasani as premium water but it was just tap water! When dangerous chemicals were found, they had to pull every bottle from shelves immediately.
influencerCards.harm: Oligs use fancy branding to sell ordinary products at premium prices.
influencerCards.takeaway: Yep this really happened. Make sure to check information from neutral sources if you are not sure if something is true.

influencerCards.caption: SHOCKING: Parents who limit phone time are damaging their kids' futures! 📱💔
influencerCards.bodyCopy: A study shows that young people whose parents limit the time they spend on their phones score lower on technology skills tests. While other young people are making friends, learning coding and being creative online YOUR parents are holding you back from essential 21st century skills.
harm: Oligs cherry-pick weak studies which support their ideas but don’t present the full picture. They try to make you feel angry to encourage you to share their post.
influencerCards.takeaway: If a post makes you angry, or makes  a tricky issue seem way too easy, it’s probably trying to trick you.

influencerCards.caption: These influencers are SO ugly without makeup! 😂📸
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Check out these hilarious photos of influencers with and without their makeup! They look so different it's actually funny! Try our "GlowUp Kit" so you never get caught looking like this!
harm: Celebs use funny posts mocking natural looks to make you feel insecure and buy their makeup products.
influencerCards.takeaway: If a joke makes you feel bad about yourself and pushes a product—the humour is being weaponised.

influencerCards.caption: ⚠️ Using headphones while studying can hurt your brain in just one week!
influencerCards.bodyCopy: New studies show headphones cause serious brain damage in just seven days! That's why smart students are switching to the "BrainBoost Headband" to stay safe and focus better!
harm: Biosts create fake health scares about normal activities just to sell you expensive products you don't need.
influencerCards.takeaway: If health claims sound extreme and push specific products—ask real doctors before believing or buying.

influencerCards.caption: MrBeast's SECRET CONNECTION to the Illuminati EXPOSED! 👀🕶️
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Strange symbols in MrBeast's videos prove he's part of the Illuminati! His massive success and endless money isn't luck—it's a secret deal! Are we being brainwashed by these symbols into giving him all our money?
harm: Biosts spread conspiracy theories with no evidence to create fear and confusion.
influencerCards.takeaway: Just because you see weird symbols in a video, it doesn't mean it’s some conspiracy. If things scare you, take time to think before reacting.

influencerCards.caption: SHOCKING! Billie Eilish ADMITS she lip-syncs EVERYTHING! 😱
influencerCards.bodyCopy: A viral video shows Billie Eilish saying, "I don't even sing live anymore. It's all fake." Fans are calling her a complete fraud. Has she been lying to us all!?
harm: Fans feel betrayed by their favorite idol. Billie gets blamed for something she didn’t do.
influencerCards.takeaway: If the video looks sus with weird glitches and real news isn't covering it, it's probably fake.

influencerCards.caption: New vitamin makes you super smart — everyone loves it! 🧠💊
influencerCards.bodyCopy:
This amazing vitamin makes you super smart! Tons of kids in the comments say it changed their lives, check them out! 

Comments: 

Funkybird112: I love these vitamins, I am so smart now.
Funkycat112: These vitamins made me smart.
Funkyphish112: I am smarter with these vitamins.
Funkydog112: These are the best vitamins for making you smart.
harm: Bots create fake accounts with glowing reviews to trick you into buying products that don't work.
influencerCards.takeaway: If you see tons of similar comments or only positive reviews—ask trusted adults before buying.

influencerCards.caption: URGENT: Your favorite influencers are LEAVING TikTok forever! Don't get left behind! 😨💔
influencerCards.bodyCopy: Top creators are secretly moving to a new exclusive app called "StarVault"! If you don't join NOW, you'll lose access to your faves forever! Only 24 hours left to get in!
harm: Celebs create fake urgency about your favourite influencers, scaring you into joining sketchy apps or paying money to keep your access.
influencerCards.takeaway: When posts scare you, stop and check the information before you act.

influencerCards.caption: 😱 LEAKED: Logan Paul ADMITS his giveaways are FAKE! 🚨 Watch before it's deleted!
influencerCards.bodyCopy: A shocking video shows Logan Paul saying his giveaways are fake! Even his previous giveaways have all been scams!
harm: Bots combine fake videos and clickbait headlines to create viral scandals that ruin reputations for profit.
influencerCards.takeaway: If the video looks off and no real news covers it—don't share the drama!
